purpose: Harder extraction, curation and descriptive headroom demonstration; no training or downstream destination.
origin: Programmatically rendered fictional procurement records from fresh structured events. Agents authored generator code; no live model writes the source documents or answer keys.

models.snapshot_limit: Official catalog exposes this model ID rather than an immutable dated snapshot; preserve CLI metadata and cached responses.
Official catalog exposes this model ID rather than an immutable dated snapshot; preserve CLI metadata and cached responses.

inference.limit: One bounded inference protocol, not each model's maximum attainable performance.

date_filter: All fixture instances are newly generated on or after 2026-10-24, later than both documented model knowledge cutoffs. No historical public examples are used as targets.
source_dates: All case creation dates are 2026-10-24; document timestamps are fictional task content.
truth: Constructor truth uses direct scenario values and Decimal price rounding; a separate event reducer uses exact integer arithmetic. Rendered pilot cases were also reviewed by agents, not human annotators.

pilot.note: The pilot was retained separately. No generator, scoring, transport or collection-policy changes followed its outputs.

historical_v1: Sources, caches, metrics, exports, figures and adjudication are retained. Hard-v2 changes task semantics and is not a matched experiment against v1.
rights_note: Code and narrative follow the repository MIT license. Model responses are identified as generated service outputs. This demonstration makes no claim of unrestricted permission to use exported responses for training other models.
spend_note: Codex CLI reports token usage but no dollar cost. Unknown USD is not zero spend.
